// One mutant per line, "original@mutated": the first occurrence of `original`
// in hardware/wifi/wifi-exec.h is replaced (scripts/check-device-programs.sh).
// The interpreter is generated (issue #494); these seed bugs in the
// handwritten image parser and wifi_start, which feed it the program, window,
// blob and declared policy, and must each change the generated executor's
// summary of some fuzzed program.

t->window = wifi_le32(image + 24);@t->window = WIFI_WINDOW_MAX;

pol->cmd_clear = wifi_le32(image + 56);@pol->cmd_clear = 0;
